symbols.name: EntityFrameworkCacheStoreProvider
symbols.summary: Owns the complete advanced-cache relational store using short bounded transactions and immutable payload generations.
symbols.remarks: Hosts deploy matching migrations and SQLite WAL/FULL settings before readiness. Native SQLite I/O is synchronous and host-local.

syntax.content: public class EntityFrameworkCacheStoreProvider : ICacheStoreProvider

symbols.name: EntityFrameworkCacheStoreProvider(string, CacheProviderOptions, Func, TimeProvider, CacheRuntimeResources, IDatabaseReadyService, ILogger, CacheDiagnosticsOptions)
symbols.summary: Creates lazy native bindings without database access. Every context returned by the host factory is independently owned and disposed.

syntax.content: public EntityFrameworkCacheStoreProvider(string name, CacheProviderOptions options, Func contexts, TimeProvider timeProvider = null, CacheRuntimeResources resources = null, IDatabaseReadyService ready = null, ILogger logger = null, CacheDiagnosticsOptions diagnostics = null)

syntax.content: public static CacheProviderCapabilities CapabilitiesFor(CacheProviderOptions options)
